blurb:

He's 40 pounds of ginger brindle, compact and goofy, and the volunteers at Mostly Mutts have been talking about him since he came in. He does best without other dogs or cats at home, and kids 15 and up are the right fit since younger kids and toddlers make him uncomfortable. His trainer will walk you through how to introduce him to other dogs, so his on-leash reactivity is very manageable.

Mostly Mutts is in Kennesaw. Visit their website to learn more about Asher and start the adoption inquiry.
